name: Subscription watch
description: Tracks subscriptions and renewals found in receipts and billing mail, keeps a ledger, and flags upcoming renewals, trials and price changes. Can check daily on a schedule.
author: Mail Triage

since_days.description: look back N days for receipts and renewal notices (default 120)

horizon_days.description: how many days ahead count as an upcoming renewal (default 30)

tools.name: watch_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions tracked from receipts and billing mail, upcoming renewals, expiring trials and noticed price changes. Use when asked about subscriptions, recurring charges, renewals or 'what am I paying for'.

horizon_days.description: window counted as an upcoming renewal (default 30)

reset.description: clear the tracked-subscription ledger before running
